neighbours.label: The possessive 's when a person's name or 'my/your/his + family word or friend' (my dad's, your mother's, his father's) or 'the + titled person' (the king's, the president's, the captain's) opens a clause's subject, before its verb ('My dad's truck broke down', 'When we arrived, my uncle's boat had left'); about 0.2-0.35 of max. Quiet: the same 's inside an object or after a preposition ('I borrowed my sister's bike', 'the door of the queen's carriage'), 'it's / he's / let's' contractions, and weaker (about 0.1) for non-person owners (the company's, the dog's, the teacher's).
neighbours.short: possessive 's opening a clause's subject (My dad's truck...)
neighbours.notes: Cold arm of the deep-cell experiment: labelled from the pole's own tops and probes only. The strongest corpus tops are split pieces of foreign words (' Comb' in 'Fasci Italiani di Combattimento', ' Tre' in 'Treffen', Chinese pieces) that did not generalise outside their exact contexts; this label covers the robust English family. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label alone.
fire: My dad's truck broke down on the highway last night.
When we arrived, my uncle's boat had already left the harbor.
Sarah's brother plays the cello in the city orchestra.
Your mother's cooking always makes the whole house smell wonderful.
The king's advisor whispered something before the feast began.
His father's watch stopped working the day after the funeral.
After the storm passed, the captain's orders were to raise the sails.
My best friend's wedding is scheduled for early June.
quiet: Everyone heard our coach's whistle from the parking lot.
一方面，兩家企業都把弱點和問題暴露在了自己的面前，以後，在選擇這兩家企業生産的産品時，可以多一個心眼、多一份慎重了；另一方面，通過兩家企業的紛爭，讓消費者更加成熟、更加理性了。
I borrowed my dad's truck to move the couch last night.
When we arrived, we climbed aboard my uncle's boat.
We went to see Sarah's brother play the cello in the city orchestra.
Everyone loves the smell of your mother's cooking in the house.
The guests whispered something to the king's advisor before the feast began.
He kept the watch of his father's after the funeral.
